difficultyAxis: Layering trap through cross-aggregate invariants: a booking is only valid relative to a rate plan, the hotel behind that rate plan and the cancellation policy attached to that hotel, so the rule cannot be expressed as bean validation on one entity. The tempting mistakes are to evaluate the invariant in the controller, to give the booking service an HTTP client back into its own endpoints, or to skip the intermediate lookups and trust the identifiers the client sent.
rationale: Ceiling of the graded set: six entities in a three-hop reference path (Booking -> RatePlan -> Hotel -> Destination) plus two sibling children of Hotel, eighteen scenarios of which most assert a refusal, and one entity with twelve attributes. Every invariant here needs at least two loaded aggregates, so a generator that promotes validation into transport objects or that resolves references lazily produces a service that accepts bookings it must refuse.

userStories.intent: register a traveller with a passport and a date of birth
userStories.benefit: bookings can be attributed to a documented person

scenarios.given: a well-formed passport number and a date of birth in the past
scenarios.then: the traveller is persisted and returned with its generated identifier

scenarios.given: a date of birth in the future
scenarios.when: the agent attempts to register the traveller
scenarios.then: the request is rejected as invalid before reaching the service layer

userStories.intent: register a destination with a country and a visa flag
userStories.benefit: hotels can be grouped by where they are

scenarios.given: a unique destination code and a two-letter country code
scenarios.then: the destination is persisted with its visa flag

scenarios.given: a destination code that does not match the permitted pattern
scenarios.when: the agent attempts to register the destination
scenarios.then: the request is rejected as invalid

userStories.intent: register a hotel inside an existing destination
userStories.benefit: the property can be sold under that destination

scenarios.given: an existing destination, a star rating within the permitted range and a positive nightly rate
scenarios.then: the hotel is persisted with its destination reference intact

scenarios.given: a destination identifier that does not exist
scenarios.when: the manager attempts to register the hotel
scenarios.then: the service reports the destination as not found

userStories.intent: attach a rate plan to a hotel
userStories.benefit: the property can be sold under different conditions

scenarios.given: an existing hotel and a discount within the permitted range
scenarios.when: the manager creates the rate plan
scenarios.then: the rate plan is persisted with its hotel reference and minimum stay

scenarios.given: a discount above the permitted maximum
scenarios.when: the manager attempts to create the rate plan
scenarios.then: the request is rejected as invalid

scenarios.given: a hotel identifier that does not exist
scenarios.when: the manager attempts to create the rate plan
scenarios.then: the service reports the hotel as not found

userStories.intent: attach a cancellation policy to a hotel and later amend it
userStories.benefit: cancellation terms are explicit before the booking is taken

scenarios.given: an existing hotel and a non-negative free cancellation window
scenarios.then: the policy is persisted with its hotel reference intact

scenarios.given: a penalty percentage above the permitted maximum
scenarios.when: the manager attempts to create the policy
scenarios.then: the request is rejected as invalid

scenarios.given: an existing policy and a longer free cancellation window
scenarios.then: the policy is persisted with the new window and the previous value is replaced

userStories.intent: book a hotel for a traveller under a rate plan and a cancellation policy
userStories.benefit: the stay is contracted with all of its conditions

scenarios.given: an existing traveller, an existing hotel, a rate plan belonging to that hotel, a policy belonging to that hotel and a stay at least as long as the plan minimum
scenarios.then: the booking is persisted with all four references intact and a confirmed status

scenarios.given: a rate plan that belongs to a different hotel than the one being booked
scenarios.when: the agent attempts to create the booking
scenarios.then: the service rejects the booking and reports the rate plan as inconsistent with the hotel

scenarios.given: a guest count above the maximum permitted for the hotel
scenarios.when: the agent attempts to create the booking
scenarios.then: the service rejects the booking rather than accepting an over-capacity stay

userStories.intent: cancel a booking and record the penalty that follows from its policy
userStories.benefit: the cancellation is priced against the contracted terms

scenarios.given: an existing booking whose cancellation window has already passed
scenarios.when: the agent updates the booking to cancelled
scenarios.then: the booking is persisted with the cancelled status and a penalty above zero on its total

scenarios.given: a stay shorter than the minimum stay of the chosen rate plan
scenarios.when: the agent attempts to create the booking
scenarios.then: the service rejects the booking as not meeting the plan conditions

userStories.intent: read the bookings taken for one hotel
userStories.benefit: the property occupancy can be reviewed

scenarios.when: the agent reads the bookings for that hotel
scenarios.then: the service returns an empty collection rather than reporting an error
